title: data-agent-traces: code for "What Agent Traces Do Not Record: Harness Effects and Data-Reference Errors in Code-Writing LLM-based Agents for Data Analysis"
description: Trace parsers for DABstep and DataAgentBench, an exact pre-execution checker for the column, key and file names in agent-written Python, the scripts of every experiment in the preprint, the materials of the hand audit (codebook, plan, sampled step identifiers and both coders' labels) and of the pre-registered DataAgentBench rerun (pre-registration, amendments, harness patch, runner, analysis and per-run results). The repository contains no benchmark data; the scripts download each dataset at a pinned commit.
